widow's peak: a V-shaped point in the hairline in the middle of the forehead
wild chamomile: annual Eurasian herb similar in fragrance and medicinal uses to chamomile though taste is more bitter and effect is considered inferior
wild cherry: the fruit of the wild cherry tree
wiper blade: a mechanical device that cleans the windshield
works council: (chiefly Brit) a council representing employer and employees of a plant or business to discuss working conditions etc.; also: a committee representing the workers elected to negotiate with management about grievances and wages etc.
wraith: a mental representation of some haunting experience
wrongfulness: that which is contrary to the principles of justice or law
yellowtail flounder: flesh of American flounder having a yellowish tail

zinc oxide: oxide of zinc; a white powder used as a pigment or in cosmetics or glass or inks and in zinc ointment
